name: IBM Plex Sans
reviewNotes: The self-hosted webfonts are IBM's own split WOFF2 subsets from the official npm release of the IBM Plex family, distributed under SIL OFL 1.1 with the Reserved Font Name "Plex"; the files ship unmodified under their family name. The package LICENSE.txt and copyright attribution were checked on 2026-09-27; local font file hashes are recorded in provenance.

name: ca-certificates
reviewNotes: The final image preserves /usr/share/doc/ca-certificates/copyright from the exact builder supplying /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt. The package contains Debian, Mozilla, and certificate-authority attribution with multiple licenses; the build-time copy is fail-closed and the package copyright file is retained verbatim.
